lesson.title: Experimental procedures
lesson.title_ar: القسم العلمي (7): المنهج التجريبي وكتابة تقارير التجارب العلمية

lines: When you carry out a scientific experiment, every stage of the process should be recorded and written up as a full report to show your results and conclusions. Such reports help you think about what you did and point you towards possible solutions to problems.
Without a correctly written-up procedure, it is impossible to monitor scientific progress or exchange scientific information.
The starting point for scientific experiments is to answer a question, for example: What happens when you heat wood/metal/plastic? Experiments should always be measurable and show cause and effect.
Reports on experimental procedures should follow these (or similar) guidelines:
QUESTION: The question should be detailed.
RESEARCH: This should be one or two sentences describing the information you know about the question. It should be the information on which you base your hypothesis.
HYPOTHESIS: This is an educated guess - a statement based on your previous research and experience that should answer the question.
MATERIALS: A list of everything needed for the experiment.
PROCEDURE: A step-by-step list of numbered instructions showing how to do the experiment. Each step should start on a new line and usually begin with a verb.
DATA: This is information collected during the experiment. It should include: • all measurements and observations  • tables showing the data  • numerical data shown as graphs
SUMMARY: The summary is one or two sentences that explain the data.
CONCLUSION: This can have four parts: • analyse the data  • see if your hypothesis was correct  • describe or explain your evidence  • identify experiment errors
Discussion: • What experiments would you like to carry out?  • Why are experiments important for progress?

blocks.edu_note_html: ملاحظات نقل حرفي (WB p. 103 & p. 104): حُفظت الصيغ المطبوعة في WB حرفياً: النقطتان في set out to.. (7 A #4)، والنقطة بعد for example. داخل الملاحظة النموذجية (7 B)، والشرطة المفردة مع مسافة في قائمة المفردات step -by-step (WB ص 116).

interactive_spot.label: أركان تقرير التجربة الثمانية وتفريق Summary عن Conclusion

simple_explain.html:
• الفرق بين الفرضية والبيانات: Hypothesis تخمين علمي مبني على القراءة والخبرة المسبقة قبل التجربة، أما Data فهي القياسات والمشاهدات والجداول والرسوم البيانية المجموعة أثناء التجربة.
  • كتابة الخطوات (Procedure): قائمة مرقّمة 1، 2، 3... يبدأ كل سطر منها بفعل أمر مثل: Measure..., Drop..., Record....
  • الفرق بين الملخص والاستنتاج: Summary يشرح البيانات في جملة أو اثنتين، أما Conclusion فيضم أربعة أجزاء: تحليل البيانات، اختبار صحة الفرضية، شرح الدليل، ورصد أخطاء التجربة.

example.html: Procedure verb rule: Bad: I put things in water. Better: 1. Fill a clear tank with 5 litres of water. 2. Place a 50g solid steel marble gently on the surface. 3. Record whether it floats or sinks.

base.ar: يبني أو يؤسس على (base hypothesis on research)

activities.prompt_literal: SCIENCE 7 A Read the introduction on PB page 71, then match the beginnings and endings of the sentences without looking at the text.
activities.prompt_ar: طابق البدايات 1–5 بالتكملات الصحيحة (a–e) في WB ص 103:

items.prompt: 1 Every stage of a scientific experiment should ... → ______
3 If the procedure isn't written up, it is impossible to... → ______

activities.prompt_literal: B Read the information about writing up experiments. Then discuss this report. What is wrong with it? (QUESTION solved as example; solve RESEARCH–CONCLUSION)
activities.prompt_ar: انقد العيوب المنهجية في أقسام التقرير السيئ السبع (WB ص 104):

items.question: RESEARCH: 'Some things float on water.'
items.model_answer: Too vague and does not provide useful scientific information to base a hypothesis on (e.g., density, shape, or trapped air inside hollow metal ships).
items.explain_ar: لم يقدّم خلفية علمية تؤسَّس عليها الفرضية.

items.question: HYPOTHESIS: 'Perhaps water is solid.'
items.model_answer: Not an educated guess based on research or experience — everyone already knows water at room temperature is a liquid, not a solid.
items.explain_ar: تخمين غير منطقي لا يستند إلى البحث ولا الخبرة.

items.question: MATERIALS: 'water, things'
items.model_answer: Incomplete and far too vague ('things'); it must list every specific item and measuring tool needed (e.g. tank of water, steel ball, empty hollow metal tin/dish, balance).
items.explain_ar: كلمة things مبهمة وتنقصها القائمة الدقيقة.

items.question: PROCEDURE: 'Put some things in water. See what happens.'
items.model_answer: Not a step-by-step numbered list, lacks measurable details and clear verbs on separate lines.

items.question: DATA: 'I put some things in water. The small heavy things sank but some of the flat heavy things floated.'
items.model_answer: Repeats procedure wording ('I put...') and lacks concrete measurements (weight/dimensions of specific named objects), structured observations, tables, or graphs.

items.question: SUMMARY: 'Flat things usually float.'
items.model_answer: Too general and unsupported by measured data (for instance, a flat solid iron plate sinks whereas hollow shaped dishes float by displacing water).
items.explain_ar: استنتاج متسرّع لا يفسّر البيانات بدقة.

items.question: CONCLUSION: 'My idea was wrong.'
items.model_answer: Too short and missing most of the four parts required: it does not analyse the data, state the original hypothesis, explain the evidence, or identify experiment errors.
items.explain_ar: اقتصر على جملة قصيرة وغاب عنه التحليل والدليل ورصد الأخطاء.

hints: قارن كل خانة بما يشترطه دليل Writing experiments على PB ص 71.

activities.prompt_literal: C Do heavy things fall faster than light things? Devise an experiment to find out. Write it up on the form below. (QUESTION: Is the speed of falling directly related to the weight of an object?)
activities.prompt_ar: نموذج تصميم وتعبئة تقرير تجربة سقوط الأجسام الثقيلة والخفيفة في استمارة 7 C (WB ص 105):
activities.guidance_literal: RESEARCH → HYPOTHESIS → MATERIALS → PROCEDURE (numbered verbs) → DATA → SUMMARY → CONCLUSION (4 parts)

steps.placeholder: RESEARCH: Gravity pulls all objects toward Earth, while air pushes upward (air resistance) more strongly on wide, flat objects than on compact spheres.  |  HYPOTHESIS: Compact heavy and light spheres of equal size will hit the ground at the same time (speed does NOT depend on weight alone).

MATERIALS: A solid iron ball (500 g), a hollow plastic ball of identical diameter (50 g), a 2-metre measuring tape, a flat tray on the floor.  |  PROCEDURE: 1. Hold both spheres at exactly 2.00 metres above the tray. 2. Release both at the exact same instant. 3. Listen and watch which hits the tray first. 4. Repeat 3 times and also compare dropping a flat sheet vs a crumpled paper ball.

steps.label_ar: DATA, SUMMARY & 4-PART CONCLUSION (البيانات، الملخص، والاستنتاج رباعي الأجزاء)
steps.placeholder: DATA: Trial 1–3: Iron ball & plastic ball hit simultaneously (at ~0.64 s); flat paper took ~1.9 s while crumpled ball (~0.66 s).  |  SUMMARY: Compact spheres of very different weights fell at the same speed, whereas flat paper slowed down.  |  CONCLUSION: Analysing the data confirms our hypothesis: falling speed is not caused by weight, because equal-sized balls reached the bottom together (our evidence); differences with flat paper came from air resistance, and timing errors come from slight hand-release delay.

hints: احرص على ثبات الشكل والحجم عند مقارنة الكتلة حتى لا يفسد مقاومة الهواء القياس.

questions.stem: According to the Writing experiments guide on PB page 71, how should every line of the PROCEDURE be written?

options.text: As a step-by-step list of numbered instructions, each starting on a new line with a verb.
As one paragraph in the past tense beginning with 'I think maybe'.
options.why_wrong: الخطوات تُكتب مرقّمة في صورة تعليمات (أفعال أمر) لا تخمينات.

options.text: Without listing materials or numbers so readers guess what to use.
options.why_wrong: قائمة MATERIALS تأتي قبلها وتحدد كل أداة مطلوبة بوضوح.

options.text: Combining hypothesis errors and graphs into one word.
options.why_wrong: الرسوم في قسم DATA، وأخطاء التجربة في قسم CONCLUSION.

hints: اقرأ السطرين المقابلين لـ PROCEDURE في PB ص 71.
questions.explain: يجب أن تكون PROCEDURE قائمة مرقمة من التعليمات يبدأ كل سطر منها بفعل أمر.

questions.stem: Why is 'Perhaps water is solid' in WB Science 7 B a poor HYPOTHESIS?

options.text: Because a hypothesis must be an educated guess based on prior research and experience, not something known to be false.
Because hypotheses must always appear inside graphs in DATA.
options.why_wrong: الرسوم البيانية تخص DATA بعد تنفيذ التجربة.

options.text: Because hypotheses should only list materials like water and metal.
options.why_wrong: سرد المواد هو وظيفة قسم MATERIALS.

options.text: Because water only exists in gas state.
options.why_wrong: الماء السائل معروف للجميع في التجارب المعتادة.

hints: انظر تعريف HYPOTHESIS في PB ص 71.
questions.explain: الفرضية العلمية هي تخمين مبني على المعرفة السابقة والبحث العلمي (educated guess)، لا افتراض يناقض الحقائق المشاهدة.
